svg.text: Python UDF 如何被打进 Rust 流水线

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 同一份 UDF，Daft 会按场景在三条路径中选择：线程 / 子进程 actor pool / 异步 + GPU

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 统一入口：UDFProject 算子（pipeline.rs 中的关键分叉）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: is_async && !use_process ⇒ AsyncUdfSink（流式） 否则 ⇒ UdfOperator（中间算子）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 并发槽 = 每个槽一份 UdfState；batch_size 以 MorselSizeRequirement::Strict(n) 强制固定行数

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 路径 A：线程内执行（默认）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 在 compute runtime 的工作线程上 Python::attach 取 GIL

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 调用 initialize_udfs + eval_expression_with_metrics

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 优点：零拷贝、无序列化开销

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 代价：受 GIL 限制，CPU 密集 UDF 无法真正并行

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 路径 B：子进程 Actor Pool（推荐）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: daft.execution.udf.UdfHandle → subprocess + UNIX socket

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 数据传输走 SharedMemory（IPC 流），非 pickle 管道

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 子进程内线程数设为 1，避免嵌套并行；含 Python object dtype 时回退线程

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 失败回传异常栈，Restore 为 UDFException；teardown 超时 5s 后 terminate

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 路径 C：异步 / GPU（AsyncUdfSink）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 每个 state 一个 JoinSet，默认最多 64 个在飞任务

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 适合 await 模型服务 / vLLM 推理：IO 等待期间不占线程

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: ResourceRequest.num_gpus 决定并发槽：available = (num_cpus / n).clamp(1, num_cpus)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 内存请求经 MemoryManager 许可后放行（spawn_with_memory_request）

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 一次 UDF morsel 的旅程

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 上游 morsel → BatchManager（按 input_id 缓冲、按行数切批）→ 取一个空闲 UdfState → spawn 到 compute runtime

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: → Rust 侧序列化输入（线程路径直接传 RecordBatch；进程路径写 SharedMemory）→ Python 侧执行 → 返回 Series/RecordBatch

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: → 与 state 一起回传 → 统计（rows in/out、耗时、放大系数）汇总到 RuntimeStatsManager → 推给进度条 / Dashboard

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 本地执行没有任务级重试：UDF 抛错即整条查询失败；重试只发生在分布式层的 worker 失效场景。

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: UDF 也是“不能被下推”的算子：优化器把它们拆成独立节点，保证在 join/聚合之后执行，并独立背压

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif

svg.text: 典型配置：@daft.func(return_dtype=..., batch_size=..., concurrency=...)；@daft.cls 支持有状态的模型加载与 GPU 资源声明。
